subject: Evaluation roadmap & ownership matrix — trial next steps
messages:
From: Emma Zhou <emma.zhou@greenglobe.com>

Cc: Tom Burns <tom.burns@greenglobe.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T16:05:00-04:00
Subject: Follow-up: today's discovery — POC scope and timing

Rafael, thanks again for a productive call earlier. A quick recap from our side and a couple of asks so we can scope the trial.

High-level goals
- Evaluate Redwood for real-time chat summaries and downstream indexing (primary), embeddings for search (secondary).
- Keep 95th %-ile latency under 250ms for typical 128-token turn.

Must-have success criteria
1) Summary quality: human-rated relevance >= 4/5 on our internal rubric across 50 test threads.
2) Embedding recall: top-10 recall >= 85% on our benchmark.
3) Performance: 95th %-ile latency <= 250ms at 10 qps with concurrency.

Infrastructure constraints
- We'll run a dedicated trial against a staging VPC; security team requires a SOC2 questionnaire before any credentials are shared.

Proposed timeline
- Share security questionnaire and POC template by EOD Friday (we expect a short internal review).
- 2-week setup window once questions answered; 3-week evaluation with checkpoints.

Can you send a one-page trial plan with clear owners (who on Redwood will own infra, who handles integration hooks, who deals with security/procurement)? Also confirm what logs/retention options we can expect.

Thanks — Emma
Emma Zhou
Senior Product Manager, GreenGlobe Logistics

--- Trial summary (executive) ---
Objective: Validate Redwood inference for low-latency chat summarization and embedding-backed search in staging.
Duration: 3 weeks evaluation (after 2-week setup).
Success criteria (short):
- Summary quality >= 4/5 (human sampling)
- Embedding recall >= 85% (top-10)
- 95th %-ile latency <= 250ms at 10 qps

Key milestones & approximate dates (US ET)
- 2026-07-03: Redwood sends completed SOC2 checklist + POC workbook (attached).
- 2026-07-06 to 2026-07-17: Staging integration (network peering + credentials + sample dataset).
- 2026-07-20 to 2026-08-09: Evaluation run and midpoint check on 2026-07-27.
- 2026-08-11: Final sync and decision meeting.

RACI (high level) — who does what
- Redwood infra & runtime setup: Responsible = Rafael Mendes; Support = Karthik Iyer; Account lead = Monica Patel
- App integration (webhooks, ingestion): Responsible = GreenGlobe engineers (Tom Burns); Support = Rafael Mendes (integration runbooks)
- Security & compliance: Responsible = GreenGlobe security; Support = Monica Patel (provide artifacts, logs access)
- Procurement & contract: Responsible = GreenGlobe procurement; Support = Monica Patel (pricing sheet, SOW)
- Evaluation metrics monitoring: Responsible = GreenGlobe PMs; Support = Redwood console + Rafael (dashboards, threshold alerts)

Immediate next steps (action owners)
- Rafael: send SOC2 + POC workbook (today EOD).
- Emma: confirm staging VPC contact and sample dataset (by Mon 7/5).
- Tom: share list of IP ranges and egress policy (by Mon 7/5).
- Monica: draft price/credits proposal for 3-week trial (by Tue 7/6).

Attachments: redwood-poc-template.xlsx (workbook), GG-security-questionnaire.pdf (received)

Notes on logs & retention
- We can provide raw request/response logs scoped to the trial; default retention for trial logs is 30 days. We can push extended retention as part of Dedicated agreements. All logs can be redacted per your PII policy; we'll coordinate with GreenGlobe security.

Let me know if you'd like this in a Shareable Drive doc; I can also set up the 30-minute kickoff for Tues 7/6 with infra and security stakeholders.

Thanks,

- Pricing/credits: For a 3-week evaluation we can offer a $5k trial credit (applied to hosted usage) and a 20% introductory discount for an initial Dedicated commit should you decide to move forward. (Responsible: Monica to send proposal).
- SOW/contract: If GreenGlobe needs an order form for the trial, Procurement can accept a short SOW; we will not require long-term commitment for the evaluation. (Tom/Emma action item to confirm).
